en.dark mode_tooltip: Burrow backgrounds will match with the mode: nighttime for dark mode and daytime for light mode.
en.fullscreen scaling_tooltip: If enabled, fullscreen will display as large as possible (toggle fullscreen to update). This may include visual artifacts.
en.no sprite antialiasing_tooltip: If enabled, sprites and patrol art will no longer be antialiased ("blurry"/"smooth") when in fullscreen.
en.custom cursor_tooltip: The cursor will be replaced with a rabbit paw. The cursor is currently unfinished and is prone to crashing.
en.keybinds_tooltip: Enables certain keybinds to be used throughout the menus for quick navigation.
en.shaders_tooltip: This will add a shading layer onto the rabbit sprites.
en.gore: Allow mild gore and blood in patrol artwork
en.gore_tooltip: Mild gore and blood will be allowed in the artwork displayed alongside patrols.
en.discord_tooltip: Discord will show info about your Warren, including your Warren name
en.check_for_updates_tooltip: Automatically checks for updates on startup
en.show_changelog_tooltip: Shows the changelog of the latest release on startup
en.special_dates_tooltip: Certain changes may be made to the game on special days such as April Fools
en.random relation: Randomize relationship values when creating Warren
en.random relation_tooltip: Warren founder rabbits will start the game with established relationships.
en.they them default_tooltip: If this setting is on, new rabbits will generate with they/them pronouns regardless of gender.
en.disasters_tooltip: This may result in up to 1/3rd of your Warren dying in one moon.
en.showxp: Show exact XP and nutrition status
en.showxp_tooltip: Will turn 'experience: proficient' into 'experience: proficient (151)'; and 'nutrition: full' into 'nutrition: full (70)'.
en.random med rabbit: Allow healer rabbits to be randomly selected on patrol
en.random med cat_tooltip: Healer rabbits can be selected with the patrol buttons +1, +3,+6.
en.fading: Allow dead rabbits to fade away
en.fading_tooltip: After 202 moons, dead rabbits will be unloaded, and saved separately. No family relations will be lost.
en.save_faded_copy: Save a complete copy of faded rabbits information
en.save_faded_copy_tooltip: A complete copy of faded rabbit save info will be saved in plain-text.
en.backgrounds_tooltip: Even with this off, the burrow you choose will still affect the events you encounter.
en.moons and seasons_tooltip: Displays Warren age and current Warren season on several pages.
en.captain: Allow chief rabbits to automatically choose a new captain
en.deputy_tooltip: The Rabbit Code rules will be taken into account when choosing a captain.
en.12_moon_graduation_tooltip: All rusasirahs will graduate at 12 moons.
en.retirement: Rabbits will never retire due to a permanent condition
en.retirement_tooltip: When this setting is off, rabbits with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire
en.become_mediator: Allow rabbits and elders to choose to become owslas
en.become_mediator_tooltip: Rabbits and elders will have a chance to become owslas upon moonskip.
en.affair: Allow rabbits to breed with rabbits that aren't their mates
en.affair_tooltip: This will allow mated and unmated rabbits to have kits with other rabbits they are not mated with. This includes, but is not limited to, affairs/cheating.
en.same sex birth_tooltip: Allow all rabbits to get pregnant despite their gender and all couples to birth kits despite same-sex status.
en.same sex adoption_tooltip: If same-sex birth is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
en.single parentage: Allow rabbits to have kits with an unknown second parent
en.single parentage_tooltip: Allow rabbits to have kits with an unknown second biological parent. The rabbit will be listed as the only biological parent.
en.romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
en.romantic with former mentor_tooltip: Allows mentors and the rabbits they trained to be romantic after they become rabbits.
en.first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
en.first cousin mates_tooltip: Allows rabbits with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.
en.by-status_tooltip: The Warren will be fed according to their status. Priority is determined by age within statuses.
en.younger first_tooltip: The youngest members of the Warren are fed first
en.less nutrition first_tooltip: The hungriest rabbits are fed first, then the rest are fed according to their status.
en.hunter first_tooltip: Proficient hunters are fed first, then the rest are fed according to status.
en.sick/injured first_tooltip: Any injured or sick rabbits are fed first to help them regain their strength, then the rest are fed according to status.
en.more experience first_tooltip: The most experienced members of the Warren are fed first.
en.ration prey_tooltip: Healthy rabbits will only eat half the food they need, even if there is enough for the Warren.
en.business as usual_tooltip: The Warren has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
en.hunting_tooltip: The Warren will focus on hunting: each working rabbit (including captain and chief rabbit) and each working rusasirah will gather additional prey on each moonskip.
en.herb gathering_tooltip: The Warren will focus on herb gathering: each healer and healer rusasirah will gather additional herbs on each moonskip due to extra help from the rabbits.
en.threaten outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with rabbits outside of the Warren decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from the rabbits.
en.seek outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with rabbits outside of the Warren increases as the rabbits make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
en.rest and recover_tooltip: The Warren will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
en.sabotage other clans_tooltip: Your owslas and rabbits work together to undermine the other Warrens. Only available if you have a working owsla. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Warrens you target.
en.aid other clans_tooltip: Your owslas and rabbits work together to help the other Warrens with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working owsla. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Warrens you target.
en.raid other clans_tooltip: Your rabbits begin crossing borders for resources. Prey and herbs will greatly increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Warrens decrease. You will be able to choose which Warrens you target.
en.hoarding_tooltip: Your rabbits begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their paws on, regardless of their own safety. Prey and herbs will increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
